name: Champignon Farmer
description:
A woodchip bed of champignons, replanted from the mushrooms themselves. Champignons have no seeds and can only be kept in containers.

Bots:
• Champignon Farmer

In each area:
• Crop(Champignon): lay woodchips (nothing to build). Set a harvest stage on it to pick only Cremini or Portobello
• Champignon: place containers (chests, cupboards…): the harvest is stored here and replanted from here, Button Mushrooms first. It can also be moved far from the bed
